title: A Kayak Shack
specs: Paddle in Morro Bay estuary, near Morro Rock, and sand dunes (not open ocean)
Wildlife includes shorebirds, raptors, harbor seals, sea lions, and sometimes sea otters
Must be 18 years or older to rent alone; children may paddle with a guardian
Weight limits: Canoes 600 lbs, double kayaks 550 lbs, single kayaks 325 lbs, paddleboards 250 lbs
Driver's license, ID, or credit card required to leave as deposit
Double kayaks hold two people plus up to two small children
includes: Life jackets and paddles included with all rentals
gap: Exact rental durations and pricing for additional hours beyond first hour not fully clear
blurb: Guests rent sit inside kayaks (single and double), canoes, and stand-up paddleboards to explore Morro Bay and the estuary. Dogs are allowed on boats but not on nearby sand dunes. Life jackets and paddles are included with rentals, and staff provide paddling tips and guidance based on skill and tides.
extraNote: No reservations; rentals are first-come, first-serve · Last rentals available 1 hour before closing (5 pm winter, 6 pm summer) · At the rental location at 10 State Park Road, Morro Bay, CA
